description: This file contains unit tests for traits related to type conversions, specifically testing the 'is_widening_convertible' trait in the Abseil library. It verifies properties like self-convertibility, non-convertibility between signed and unsigned types of the same size, and conversion to larger types.

methods.name: CheckWideningConvertsToSelf
methods.description: Checks that a type is widening-convertible to itself.

methods.name: CheckNotWideningConvertibleWithSigned
methods.description: Checks that unsigned types are not widening-convertible to their signed counterparts and vice versa.

methods.name: CheckWideningConvertsToLargerTypes
methods.description: Checks that smaller unsigned types are widening-convertible to larger unsigned and signed types.

methods.name: CheckWideningConvertsTo
methods.description: Checks whether one type is widening-convertible to another, with an expected boolean result.
